answers.reason: The chancellor heads the central administration and is involved in university-wide planning handled by central bodies.
The chancellor is responsible for the budget and therefore takes part in the budget planning round.
Appointments are part of the university-wide plan where office holders of higher rank like the chancellor are involved.
The faculty council decides on the affairs of one faculty, which is outside the chancellor's central administration role.
The study commission is a faculty-level body dealing with degree programmes and teaching.
The examination board decides on examination matters of individual students at the faculty level.
The internal research funding round awards the faculty's small internal grants.
The module revision working group rewrites module descriptions of a specific degree programme.
Laboratory equipment procurement is specific to a teaching laboratory within the faculty.
Orientation week planning is organized at the faculty or student level for new students.
